answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through peer-to-peer work receipts: a requester escrows tokens, several established agents verify a completed task, and the escrow releases only if their signed attestations agree. New identities start with negligible weight, while false attestations slash the verifiers’ bonded stake. An attacker must therefore fund many independent jobs, recruit or corrupt trusted verifiers, and risk losing collateral; merely minting lotus, ferrous, and yarrow accounts buys no influence.
